snippet.description:
A recent study has identified 219 hanging glaciers in Uttarakhand's Alaknanda basin, raising concerns about the potential risks posed by unstable ice and steep Himalayan terrain. Nearly one-third of the identified unstable ice mass is located in the Upper Alaknanda basin.

If unstable ice breaks away, it can trigger an ice-rock avalanche, which may lead to secondary hazards such as debris flows and Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs). These events can pose serious risks to downstream communities, roads, bridges and infrastructure
